reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer (packet-only: competency text + rendered samples, no generator source), 2026-07-27 re-review batch

samples_reviewed.question_text: What is the total value of 1 ₱5 coin and 1 ₱1 coin?
What is the total value of 1 ₱10 coin, 1 ₱5 coin, and 1 ₱1 coin?
What is the total value of 1 ₱10 coin and 3 ₱1 coins?
What is the total value of 1 ₱5 coin and 2 ₱1 coins?
What is the total value of 1 ₱10 coin and 2 ₱5 coins?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: All five seeds (42-46) ask 'What is the total value of ...', which is an addition task. The competency's verb is 'Recognize' and its object includes 'their notations'; no sampled item shows a coin or bill and asks the learner to name it, match it to its ₱ notation, or read a notation aloud.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: 'bills up to ₱100' is wholly unrealized. Across every seed only ₱1, ₱5 and ₱10 coins are used, so the ₱20, ₱50 and ₱100 bills that the wording explicitly names are never once presented to the learner.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Each stem is a single short clause and the sums 6, 16, 13, 7 and 20 sit inside Grade 1 addition fluency; the ten-times distractors (60 at seed 42, 160 at seed 43) model a realistic place-value slip rather than a random number.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: One sentence frame is reused verbatim five times with only the piece counts changed. There is no picture-of-a-coin identification item, no 'which of these is a ₱10 coin', and no notation-to-word matching, so the recognition variants this lc implies are entirely missing.

competency_alignment.rationale: The only movement in the set is from two coins (seed 42) to three coins (seed 43), which strengthens additive fluency; nothing in the sequence incrementally builds a learner's ability to recognize denominations or their written notation.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The stated ceiling is ₱100 but the largest quantity produced anywhere is ₱20 (seed 46, one ₱10 coin plus two ₱5 coins), so roughly four fifths of the mandated range is never exercised.
